identity.name: Explorer
identity.one_liner: The Explorer's 2021 return to 36mm, with caliber 3230.

narrative.story: After eleven years at 39mm, the Explorer went back to its historic 36mm size in 2021 as the 124270, carrying the 3230 and the black-dial 3-6-9 layout that traces to the Everest-era originals of 1953. It is the smallest and simplest current professional Rolex, and one of the more obtainable at retail.
narrative.collector_notes: The spec is fixed — no dial or bezel variants — so condition and completeness set the price. The 36mm size divides buyers; try it on before assuming it wears small.
